title: No state one is wholly unaware of is conscious

statements.text: No mental state is conscious if the one who is in it is in no way aware of being in it. Higher-order theories take this common-sense observation, also used in experimental work on nonconscious perception, as their starting point.

sources.quote: The basic motivation is that no mental state is conscious if one is wholly unaware of being in such a mental state.
No mental state is conscious if the individual that is in that state is in no way aware of it.
